title: 'Donate your $1 trillion fortune by 2036': Nobel economist challenges Elon Musk after his 'money won't matter' prediction
summary_full: Nobel laureate Daron Acemoglu challenged Elon Musk to donate his fortune by 2036.  Musk responded positively, suggesting he may consider a major philanthropic move.  His past giving has focused on science, education, and technology initiatives.  Donating such a vast sum presents practical challenges regarding asset transfer and oversight.  This potential commitment marks a notable shift in his philanthropic approach.
